description: Beijing City Transport Road Network Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Shilin Zhang. "Traffic sensor networks frequently suffer from missing data due to equipment failures and communication disruptions, degrading downstream intelligent transportation system (ITS) applications that depend on complete observations. We propose MAST-GNN, a Masked Autoencoder-based Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network that reconstructs missing traffic measurements through co-optimized spatial, temporal, and loss components tailored to the reconstruction objective. Coverage: Beijing. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
